segments.text: "Not happening. I keep telling you."

A young man who values his peace and quiet. Despite his protests, Aoba has a hard time refusing people in need. An optimist at heart, he rarely gets angry, but when he does, expect him to deliver an explosive kick or two. He’s been plagued by chronic headaches for as long as he can remember.
From the digital manual included with r76424

"What kind of man would I be if I said no to that?"
Aoba’s best friend, a wandering street hairdresser whose skills and flawless smile have made him hugely popular with the district’s female population.

Aoba’s Allmate. An older model, Ren requires regular maintenance, which Aoba performs himself. His calm advice has pulled Aoba out of many a sticky situation.

Usui's true form. Allmate of Toue.
"You might be surprised how much you like it."
The leader of Dry Juice, the district’s largest Ribsteez team. He looks down on Rhyme players and respects Aoba for not taking part in the fad.
From the digital manual included with r76424
"They say Allmates resemble their owners."
Mink’s Allmate. His eyepatch and cigar give him a dignified air. Mink hasn’t given him a name, and simply calls him "tori"―"bird."
From the digital manual included with r76424
"If you wanna fight, take it outside. I'm tired of listening to your bickering."
Aoba's grandmother, a strict but kind old lady who’s looked after him all his life. A pharmacist, she designed the medicine that keeps Aoba's headaches at bay.
From the digital manual included with r76424
"Where do you fuckers think you are?! YOU'RE ALL UNDER ARREST!!!"
A cop feared throughout the district for his tyrannical policing and villainous appearance. Is never seen without his megaphone.
From the digital manual included with r76424
"Phew, the deliveries were all over the place today."
Aoba's boss, the owner of Hum-Drum Junk. Don't speak the forbidden phrase unless you want to see what lies beneath that mild-mannered exterior.
From the digital manual included with r76424
A tattoo artist known for his intricate designs.
"I said, wake up! Or I'm gonna kick your ass!"
Koujaku’s Allmate. Known for his stylish geta sandals.
